reason: YouTube Studio already shows me my analytics every morning and ChatGPT can brainstorm titles and thumbnail ideas for free. I've never paid for a creator tool, and I can't see what Mitra gives me that those two don't already.
objection: It reads the same analytics that YouTube Studio shows me for free, so I'd be paying to get a summary of numbers I can already look at.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me a specific, actionable reason why a video flopped that Studio and ChatGPT can't tell me, and that held up on my own channel over a month of use.
